title: Background intake: Issue -> run -> PR
description: Slice 5. Issue labelled ready-for-agent triggers /analyze in the background; result is a PR linking the Issue with the full Finding directory; missing definition approval or provisional sign-off pauses with a needs-input result on the Issue; reruns are idempotent (no duplicate PRs); hook precedes any unattended run. Workflow boundary test with fake Issue and harness interfaces feeding a real fixture Finding.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Label -> PR with linked Issue in boundary test
- [ ] Needs-input pause exercised
- [ ] Duplicate trigger yields no second PR

title: Distribution: plugin, skills.sh, npm, docs
description: Slice 6. Plugin manifest listing promoted skills, skills.sh-compatible layout, openai.yaml per skill with invocation policy in sync, npm package for the CLI, install smoke test, docs page per promoted skill, README with install block, MIT + Matt Pocock notice where wording adapted.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] claude plugin validate passes; install smoke green
- [ ] npx aftergrid check/render work from a clean machine
- [ ] Every promoted skill has a docs page and openai.yaml

title: Execute + Check via DuckDB adapter
description: Slice 1. Adapter contract (execute with typed columns, capture with content hashes, open-retained, privilege probe, non-executing estimate with unknown, resource limits, statement guard, catalog read) implemented for DuckDB. Snapshot = immutable retained copy with hashes. One reconciliation Check (canonical definition SQL vs analysis result) runs through the adapter against retained inputs; a failing reconciliation and a Snapshot hash mismatch are red.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] check executes fixture SQL and Checks against retained inputs, never live
- [ ] Snapshot hashes recorded; mismatch fixture fails
- [ ] Minimal seam-2 suite green on DuckDB (execute, capture, open-retained, guard rejects DDL/DML)
- [ ] Guard admits reads only via estimate under cap or documented fallback; LIMIT alone never passes

title: Evidence-model negatives
description: Slice 2. Every evidence rule enforced and red for the right reason: decimal precision preserved, null vs not-available vs zero, display-only rounding, derivation op set with declared operands/units/zero-denominator behaviour and cycle rejection, duplicate row keys, missing columns, hand-typed data-bearing numerals, typed external sources for targets, Claim type + Recheck policy presence and shape (incl. not-automatically-evaluable state), definition kind metric|diagnostic separate from lifecycle, published decision metric citing proposed or unversioned definition.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Each seam-1 negative fixture fails with the expected category
- [ ] Recheck policy + falsifier + Decision-record shapes validated per ag-revisit-schema-rb8
- [ ] Diagnostic calculations allowed with status shown; published metric requires approved + pinned version

title: First real Finding: Spot Sports podcast/video readout
description: Slice 4. Set up the private Instance in spot_sports (analytics/), approve the podcast/video metric definitions, add the first Reader profile (non-technical product owner), run /analyze on the readout Question against a Postgres extract, review and merge the Finding, render it. No Spot Sports schema, metrics or ids enter the aftergrid repo.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Finding passes check (validity + readiness) and renders
- [ ] Reader subagent passes under the named profile
- [ ] Decision record written by the owner
- [ ] Postgres-backed seam-1 run recorded

title: /grill-question + /checked-analysis
description: Slice 3. /grill-question (user-invoked) runs grilling + domain-modeling: raw ask -> Question (decision, metric, population, window, machine-checkable falsifier, Reader); proposes definitions as proposed; updates Instance glossary. /checked-analysis (model-invoked): pre-registers the primary comparison, writes invariant + reconciliation Checks before the analysis query, runs against a Snapshot, records Diagnostic calculations with status.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Question artifact validates against manifest shape
- [ ] Checks exist before analysis SQL runs; run order enforced
- [ ] Falsifier stored as Check ref + expected outcome

title: Guardrail hook
description: Slice 5. Claude Code PreToolUse hook blocking shell/SQL invocations that write, run DDL or exceed budget; provisional-read path requires recorded human sign-off, logs reason code, results never rendered; hard permissions/privacy/limits have no bridge. Installable by setup; tested against alternate access paths (psql, duckdb CLI, node one-liners).
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Write/DDL/over-budget attempts blocked with reason
- [ ] Alternate-path tests red without hook, green with
- [ ] Provisional read without sign-off blocked

title: /iterate-visual + /revise-finding
description: Slice 3. /iterate-visual: render -> view PNG -> score against Storytelling-with-Data rubric -> revise; three passes maximum, still-failing chart returned to Operator; score advisory only. /revise-finding (user-invoked): Operator feedback -> re-render + re-check; Variants share pinned evidence; presentation-only changes allowed; number/query or interpretation changes (causal wording, hidden comparison, aggregation, axis truncation) reopen analysis/review; writes Decision records (owner, action or inaction, rationale, date, revisit condition, Claim ids).
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Loop stops at 3 and reports failure to Operator
- [ ] Interpretation change detected and review invalidated
- [ ] Decision record written with required fields; merge never creates one

title: Postgres adapter + capability matrix
description: Slice 4. Adapter contract for Postgres: capture of declared dependency tables inside one REPEATABLE READ transaction with content hashes; open-retained restores extracts into a disposable compatible Postgres with recorded schema/runtime requirements and reruns original SQL there, never falling back to live; EXPLAIN (no ANALYZE) estimate in planner units with unknown; statement_timeout/work_mem limits; guard with no LIMIT exemption; privilege probe; catalog read. Capability matrix generated from suite sections; PostHog managed warehouse listed unvalidated.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Seam-2 suite parameterised over DuckDB + Postgres green
- [ ] Mutate live after capture; rerun from retained inputs reproduces original result
- [ ] LIMIT query with over-cap estimate rejected; unknown estimate follows documented fallback
- [ ] Unsupported capability fails or explicit fallback, never green/zero

title: Publication binding: digest, attestations, export projection
description: Slice 2. Digest envelope over semantic manifest + memo/query/Check/chart/result contents, excluding digest, attestations and volatile timestamps. Attestations (Check results, definition approvals, reviews) bind to the digest and are verified against a trust source independent of agent-editable fields: allowlisted human account approval at an exact repository revision. check report separates evidence validity from publication readiness and never mutates hashed content. render for publication refuses unbound/stale attestations; draft preview allowed and labelled.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Stale digest, forged self-authored attestation, post-attestation edit each fail publication
- [ ] Changing only a Claim type or exclusion invalidates the Finding review; cosmetic edit does not require definition re-approval
- [ ] Definition approval binds definition content; Finding approval binds Finding digest
- [ ] Draft render works without attestations, labelled, reader-safe projection applied

title: Render to inspected HTML
description: Slice 1. Vega-Lite subset validator (allowlist over nested/layered specs and encodings; no transform, aggregate, bin, timeUnit, stack-normalise, inline data, URLs) and renderer to SVG (PNG for agent viewing) with shared house style. `aftergrid render` produces one self-contained HTML: Answer first, per-Claim understand/inspect expansion (population, comparison, window, exclusions, calculation), trust facts as separate lines, coverage + generated-at + canonical location, single mailto action with Finding + Claim ids only, draft label when unattested.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] render succeeds on both fixtures; forbidden chart spec fails validation
- [ ] HTML contains no field outside export policy; sentinel test on HTML + SVG incl. metadata
- [ ] Reader action carries ids, no values
- [ ] Draft label present when attestations absent

title: /analysis-review + /analyze + first golden eval
description: Slice 3. /analysis-review dispatches Method, Question and Reader subagents (Reader adopts Instance profile) in parallel, returns blocking/non-blocking findings. /analyze (user-invoked) declares the gate order: grill -> checked-analysis -> write-finding -> iterate-visual -> analysis-review -> check; halts with reason on any blocking finding; inconclusive is a valid outcome. One golden Question seeded on the fixture data runs end to end and asserts answer/abstention, definition id, tables read.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] /analyze produces a check-passing Finding from a raw ask on fixture data
- [ ] Blocking review finding halts the run with reason
- [ ] First golden eval green and stored with skill version, git SHA, model id

title: aftergrid revisit (v0.1): re-test merged Findings against refreshed Snapshot
description: ADR 0009 (amended). v0.1: refresh Snapshot as new retained inputs -> rerun executions under each Claim's declared window policy -> evaluate each Recheck policy + the Question's falsifier -> new revision reporting per Claim: holds / contradicted / insufficient data / not comparable (distinct from engine Check failures; non-evaluable is an explicit state, never a fabricated boolean). Lists the Decision records resting on each Claim; the decision owner judges, the Engine never infers 'decision holds'. Decision log rendered as a board. Marketing: 'the analysis that re-checks itself'.

title: Revisit schema in v0 manifest: Recheck policy, falsifier Check, Decision-record revisit condition
description: ADR 0009 (amended). v0 manifest carries, per Claim, a tagged Recheck policy: predicate + threshold/direction, comparison method or versioned method ref, evidence refs, tolerance units + baseline where applicable, minimum-data/coverage, window policy (fixed-window restatement vs advancing-window), OR not-automatically-evaluable + reason (explicit state, never a fabricated boolean). Question falsifier = Check ref + expected outcome, distinct from non-evaluable. Decision record = Claim ids it rests on + revisit condition (schedule and/or falsifier ref); window policy lives on the Claim, not the Decision record. check validates shape + references only; no evaluator in v0. Recheck results (holds / contradicted / insufficient data / not comparable) are distinct from engine Check failures. Sources: spec, ADR 0001-0009.

title: /setup-aftergrid
description: Slice 4. User-invoked setup: scaffolds the Instance (definitions, readers, findings, decision log, golden Questions), verifies mattpocock-skills is installed (exact install line if not), writes a connection profile and refuses a role whose probed privileges include write/DDL, installs the guardrail hook via the hook-point, records the tracker choice. Hard vs soft dependency split documented.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Fresh repo -> usable Instance in one run; rerun idempotent
- [ ] Write-capable role refused with reason
- [ ] Setup smoke test in CI

title: Skeleton + Finding contract fixtures
description: Slice 1. Repo layout mirroring mattpocock-skills (buckets, CLAUDE.md rules, plugin manifest stub), TypeScript CLI scaffold, Instance layout, Reader-profile format with generic fallback, and two hand-written fixture Findings (one numeric, one nonnumeric/insufficient-data) on a tiny DuckDB input. `aftergrid check` validates manifest schema (schema_version, ids, executions, result sets with row keys/types/units, Claims with type + Recheck policy, export policy, owner contact) and resolves every evidence reference by row key. Defines the contract /write-finding must later produce.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] check passes on both fixtures; fails with category report on a fixture with an unresolved reference
- [ ] Instance layout + Reader-profile format documented and consumed by check
- [ ] Reference grammar has restricted id charset; row-key resolution only
- [ ] Seam-1 harness runs both fixtures in CI

title: Synthetic dataset + golden suite + nightly eval
description: Slice 6. Deterministic generator: PostHog-shaped users/events/subscriptions with planted effects (churn spike, broken funnel step, mix shift) and failure fixtures (duplicate joins, zero denominators, late events, missing instrumentation, bad references, insufficient data). 3-5 golden Questions with expected answer or expected abstention and tolerances. Nightly workflow runs /analyze end to end and stores results with skill version, git SHA, model id.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Generator reproducible from seed
- [ ] Golden suite includes at least one expected-abstention case
- [ ] Nightly job green at least once; not a merge gate

title: v0 milestone evidence
description: Slice 6. Assemble the release: golden suite green at the release revision; Reader smoke test on the real Finding (one outside person explains the Answer, names denominator + a limitation, picks an action); capability matrix published; repo flipped public; formative study scheduled as the external-release gate.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Golden green at tagged revision
- [ ] Reader smoke test recorded
- [ ] Capability matrix published; PostHog managed warehouse marked unvalidated
- [ ] Repo public

title: v0: one Finding end to end
description: Spec: docs/spec/v0-one-finding-end-to-end.md (public mirror: GitHub issue #1). Design: docs/design/v0-design-2026-09-15.md. Glossary: CONTEXT.md. ADRs: docs/adr/0001-0009. Independent review reconciled in docs/design/reconciliation-2026-09-15.md; cleared for ticketing at 532bd78.
design:
Slices (CobaltSpring review 2026-09-15), each ends in a passing seam test:
1. One retained DuckDB answer to inspected HTML: minimal Instance/Reader contracts, tiny hand-written numeric + nonnumeric fixture Findings, real execution, one Check, evidence ref + chart, typed trust facts, render + mailto. Seam 1 + minimal seam 2.
2. Reject invalid evidence and unsafe publication: precision/nulls/derivations, nested chart allowlist, export projection, approval/digest binding, diagnostic/provisional states, Revisit recheck-policy validation. Seam-1 negatives.
3. Author and revise the same artifact: /write-finding, /shape-narrative, /iterate-visual (3-pass max, Variants), profile selection; then /grill-question + /checked-analysis + /analysis-review + /analyze orchestrate the same contracts. Fixture tests + one seeded golden eval.
4. Onboard and run on Postgres: setup contract, source permission checks, capture + open-retained rerun (disposable Postgres restore), capability declarations, limits. Seam 2 + Postgres-backed seam-1 Finding.
5. Run asynchronously: hook install + enforcement, Issue dispatch, needs-input pause, idempotency, PR linkage. Workflow boundary test with fake issue/harness interfaces.
6. Distribution + milestone evidence: package/install smoke, expanded synthetic failures, both adapter suites, golden eval suite green at release revision, Reader smoke study.
Contracts that precede /write-finding: Instance layout, Reader-profile format + fallback, Question/Claim/Decision-record shapes, approval + export metadata.
Stories not observable at seams 1/2 (1-8, 18-23, 29-35, 48) carry named acceptance evidence: setup/workflow/install smoke, nightly model eval, or Reader exercise. Stories 40-42 are v0.1 runtime.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] golden Questions green in CI on synthetic dataset
- [ ] first Spot Sports Finding (podcast/video readout) passes Reader reviewer under non-technical product owner profile
- [ ] one outside person explains Answer in own words, names denominator + a limitation, picks an action
- [ ] every displayed number resolves from a saved result; check + render pass on fixtures
notes: COMPLETED: design grilled, reviewed by CobaltSpring, reconciled; spec written (docs/spec) and mirrored to GitHub #1. IN PROGRESS: nothing. NEXT: /to-tickets against the spec -> child beads under this epic. KEY DECISIONS: internal dev tracking = beads (br); product Instance intake stays GitHub Issues (a feature, not our process).

title: /write-finding + /shape-narrative
description: Slice 3. Model-invoked skills, written under writing-for-agents: /write-finding produces the fixed sections and manifest exactly as the fixture contract requires, selecting the named Reader profile (generic fallback); /shape-narrative enforces answer-first, one Claim per Evidence subsection, chart title = Claim, Reader-level language, Claim type + caveat beside the Answer. Output passes check.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Skill output on the fixture Question passes check (validity) with zero manual edits
- [ ] Nonnumeric outcome produces a valid Finding
- [ ] Narrative lint rules enforced by check; reviewer criteria named for what lint cannot see
